snippet.title: 『Yunyun Syndrome!? Rhythm Psychosis』Second Trailer
snippet.description:
The Steam release of ""Yunyun Syndrome!? Rhythm Psychosis"" is set for April 2026!

\ Denpa Song × Copypasta × Rhythm Game /
A rhythm adventure game about a psychotic hikikomori girl - also an avid anonymous poster - who corrupts the world with her severe brain rot from listening to too many denpa songs.

🎵 Wishlist “Yunyun Syndrome!? Rhythm Psychosis” on Steam now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2914150/

📡━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━📡
